A blue and white calendar is affixed to the wall behind her. (2) A young man wearing a grey oversized t-shirt, grey cargo pants with distinctive large black side pockets, and a black face mask enters the frame from the right. He stands with his hands tucked into his pockets, observing the woman while she continues her static stretch. In the background, a modern kitchen area is visible, featuring white cabinetry, a kitchen counter with a sink, and a high-backed grey bar stool. (3) The scene cuts to a living room where the same man is lying on a dark grey L-shaped sofa. He is holding a large, black cylindrical professional speaker horizontally over his torso, pushing it upward in a rhythmic, exercise-like motion. The lighting in this scene is warmer and dimmer, provided by a corner floor lamp. Bold yellow text overlays with black borders appear at the top and center-bottom of the frame.
